preservedDistinctions: Whole-site morning communication versus trade-specific preparation; attendance not whole task confirmation.
Daily safety meeting reflects changed equipment/conditions; danger names versus concrete mitigation; yesterday tool check not today result.
Safety cycle continuous through changing day; patrol observations/instructions versus verified correction.
Separate schedules versus shared place/time agreement; work end versus residual openings/materials/fire/public risk management.
Hire/task-change safety-health training versus prior experience; injury danger versus health harm; operation instruction versus inspection/PPE/emergency/health education.
Training duration versus content/understanding; new site induction versus hire education or old entry card.
Mixed trades need shared coordination; command names versus contact method/location; distributed material versus comprehension; principal/related employers share execution information.
Helmet/shoes/full harness protect different targets; conformity marking versus current damage; past new condition not post-use evidence.
Fall clearance/anchorage conditions versus height alone; old-standard transition and use obligation distinct, no current dates/thresholds invented.
Grinding eye protection versus welding light attenuation; transparent lens/shield not universal light/gas protection.
Dust filtration versus hazardous gas/oxygen supply; owning dust mask not oxygen-deficiency mitigation.
Glove material/task compatibility and rotating entanglement risk; no universal glove rule.
Air temperature versus heat-stress index including humidity/heat; outdoor forecast not indoor hot-equipment assessment.
Cooling/rest facilities versus accessible time/work plan and individual/environment checks; endurance statement not authorization to continue.
Suspected heat-illness changes routed to prescribed reporting; green cross/first-aid sign versus contents/location/contact/emergency information.
